botAccess.title: Project access of {name}
botAccess.managedHelp: The access of this token follows the project connection that manages it. Change it in the project's Execution settings.
botAccess.scopeWorkspaceHelp: The token acts in every project of the workspace with the permissions it was created with.
botAccess.scopeProjectsHelp: The token acts only where you give it a level below. Other projects get the level of "Other projects".
botAccess.noProjects: This workspace has no projects yet.
botAccess.needsWrite: A level that allows comments or writing only takes effect for a token with the Write permission. This token does not have it, so it can still only read.
